subject: Welcome to Bath & Body Works: Discover Your Signature Fragrance
body: Welcome to the Bath & Body Works community! Founded in 1990 in New Albany, Ohio, we are a global leader in personal care and home fragrance. We are thrilled to elevate your everyday routines with our world-famous scented body care, legendary 3-wick candles, and nourishing hand soaps. Explore our latest collections today to find your new favorite scent and experience a world of fragrance.

subject: Your Home Fragrance Destination: Transform Any Room with 3-Wick Candles
body: Discover how Bath & Body Works can help you create the ultimate cozy atmosphere with our world-renowned 3-wick candles and concentrated room sprays. Whether you are setting a relaxing mood or refreshing your living space with seasonal aromas, our products deliver unbeatable fragrance performance. Shop our newest arrivals today to customize your home scent experience.

subject: Scented Self-Care: Nourish Your Skin with Our Body Care Collections
body: Ready to pamper your skin? Discover Bath & Body Works’ luxurious body care line, featuring our bestselling body lotions, shower gels, and fine fragrance mists. Crafted with nourishing ingredients and unforgettable scents, our products help you indulge in daily wellness and self-care. Visit your Bath & Body Works account today to explore our latest beauty drops and exclusive offers.

subject: Clean Hands, Happy Days: Refresh with Our Nourishing Hand Soaps
body: Simplify your daily hygiene routine by stocking up on Bath & Body Works’ gentle foaming hand soaps. Infused with essential oils, shea extract, and vitamin E, our soaps wash away dirt and germs while leaving your hands feeling soft and clean. It is a simple way to bring a touch of luxury to your sink. Open the Bath & Body Works app today to view your favorite scents.

subject: Manage Your Rewards and Fragrance Favorites Instantly with Bath & Body Works
body: Shopping your favorite scents should be effortless. With the Bath & Body Works app and digital channels, you can seamlessly track your loyalty rewards, check out exclusive member deals, and order your go-to body care and 3-wick candles right from your phone. Log in to your account today to put fabulous fragrance right at your fingertips.
